stem: Pus from a post-operative wound grows golden colonies that are catalase-positive and coagulase-positive and ferment mannitol on mannitol-salt agar. Which organism is identified, and which single test best separates it from other staphylococci?
concept: Staphylococcus aureus is catalase-positive (separating staphylococci from streptococci) and, crucially, coagulase-positive (separating it from S. epidermidis and S. saprophyticus); it also ferments mannitol. Optochin and bacitracin sensitivity are tests used for streptococci, not staphylococci.
subject: Microbiology
